Gunita is for adults aged 18 and older. The checkbox is self-attestation and does not verify age.
Keep your password private. Your permane: Keep your password private. Your permanent pseudonym connects your thoughts across the service. Do not impersonate others or misuse accounts.
You are responsible for what you share. Community rules apply to all content. Legal terms, jurisdiction, operator identity and contact details require external review before launch.
Your email, password hash and sessions a: Your email, password hash and sessions are private. Permanent pseudonyms allow correlation across posts; Gunita does not promise untraceability.
Locations will be approximate and chosen: Locations will be approximate and chosen manually, not proof of presence. Authored details can still identify you. Do not share addresses, full names or phone numbers.
Thoughts expire after 30 days in the liv: Thoughts expire after 30 days in the live database. Account deletion removes related live content and revokes sessions. Encrypted backups may retain prior copies for a rolling seven days; saved copies held by others cannot be erased.
Local storage holds only warning version: Local storage holds only warning version, language and theme preferences. Local test email uses Mailpit. Production processors, rights requests, retention exceptions and operator contact channels require legal/privacy review before launch.
Ordinary non-graphic grief, heartbreak,: Ordinary non-graphic grief, heartbreak, loneliness and distress are welcome. Make room for difficult feelings with care for others.
Do not post private identifying details,: Do not post private identifying details, targeted harassment, credible threats, scams, sexual exploitation, or encouragement or instructions for self-harm or violence.
The warning does not waive these rules. Moderation and reporting policies require editorial and legal review before public launch.
Gunita is not an emergency response or c: Gunita is not an emergency response or crisis counseling service. If you feel unsafe, consider reaching out to a trusted person nearby or seeking local professional support.
Crisis-resource contacts are intentional: Crisis-resource contacts are intentionally pending verification. No helpline numbers or unverified services are listed in this draft. Phase 7 must verify current Philippine resources and editorial wording before public launch.
This draft has been checked against the: This draft has been checked against the local implementation specification; it is not legal advice or certification. External legal, privacy, native-language and crisis-resource review remain launch blockers.
